notApplicable.reason: artifact entity mutation targets one entity version and emits one archive event; the mutation boundary has no collection input.
artifact entity mutation targets one entity id and emits one delete event; no entity collection is enumerated.
artifact entity import processes one submitted artifact entity; imported payload membership is outside this event writer.
artifact entity mutation updates one entity version; it has no collection or batch input.
compiled entity-delete event has one agent id and scalar reason; packages/daemon/src/entity-action-catalog-executor.ts does not enumerate an agent collection.
compiled entity upsert has one agent document; the catalog compiler consumes one target and has no collection input.
compiled agent-retired event reads one current entity revision; no collection is traversed.
relation assignment migration is a single relation event; assignment-history growth is measured by the assign/unassign probes.
dispatch-review is a single Decision catalog runtime request; the action payload has no collection field or batch traversal.
rematerialize targets one Decision document and emits one catalog event; no collection is traversed by the writer.
fact promotion is a single declared-only event with scalar fact id and target fields; no collection is read at this boundary.
declared-only document conflict overwrite emits one conflict event for one path; document-count and body-size dimensions are measured on doc-submit.
declared-only document conflict resolution addresses one path and emits one event; it has no collection input.
declared-only document retirement addresses one document path and emits one event; no document collection is scanned.
fact reclassification reads one fact and compiles one fact event; it does not enumerate facts.
fact rematerialization targets one fact document; the batch fact collection dimension is measured by fact-archive.
fact type registration appends one scalar type declaration; no fact collection is traversed.
fact unarchive reads one fact and compiles one event; it has no collection input.
migration import is a declared-only ingress for one import request; imported member counts are outside this canonical event writer.
person delegation runtime targets one principal and one delegation edge; it has no collection or batch field.
delegation revoke targets one principal and one edge; the runtime does not enumerate a collection.
preset upgrade is a single task catalog runtime mutation with scalar preset data; no collection is read by the write boundary.
relation reconfirm compiles one relation event identified by relationId; owner relation traversal is measured by relation-relate.
relation unrelate compiles one relation retirement event; it does not scan the owner relation collection.
runtime-session lifecycle event records one session state change with scalar payload; no collection is traversed.
runtime-session exit event records one session outcome; no collection is traversed.
runtime-session liveness event records one status update; no collection is traversed.
runtime-session outcome event records one observation; no collection is traversed.
runtime-session provider binding records one provider reference; no collection is traversed.
runtime-session start event records one session; no collection is traversed.
runtime-session task binding records one task reference; no collection is traversed.

schedule delete runtime removes one schedule definition; it does not enumerate schedules.
schedule disable runtime updates one schedule definition; no schedule collection is traversed.
schedule dispatch-link runtime updates one link; no collection is traversed.
schedule enable runtime updates one schedule definition; no collection is traversed.
schedule missed runtime records one occurrence; no occurrence collection is traversed.
schedule settle runtime updates one occurrence; no collection is traversed.
schedule update runtime updates one schedule definition; no collection is traversed.
script execution is a declared-only event for one execution request; script output collection is outside this writer.
settings update runtime replaces one repository settings record; it has no collection input.
squad cancel runtime updates one squad; no squad member collection is read by this writer.
compiled entity-delete event has one squad id and scalar reason; no squad collection is enumerated.
compiled entity upsert has one squad document; the catalog compiler consumes one target.
squad run runtime targets one squad run; it has no collection or batch field.
task annotation runtime appends one scalar annotation to one execution; it does not enumerate annotations.
task archive runtime updates one task record; no task collection is traversed.
artifact-add runtime writes one named artifact; the task-submit artifact collection dimension covers multi-artifact publication.
task attestation runtime records one gate witness; it has no collection input.
completion validation consumes the fixed closeout gate set for one execution; gate receipt cardinality is contract-bounded and not a user collection.
contract migration targets one task package and one schema version; no task collection is traversed.
executor declaration updates one execution identity; no collection is traversed.
task delete runtime removes one task aggregate; it has no collection or batch field.
escalation writes one task escalation record with scalar options; no collection is traversed.
escalation resolution writes one response for one dispatch; no collection is traversed.
task push forwards one branch publication request; repository file enumeration is outside the canonical event writer.
task release updates one lease holder; no task collection is traversed.
task rematerialize targets one task package; artifact collection scaling is measured by task-submit.
task reopen updates one task status; no collection is traversed.
rework updates one execution and task iteration; no collection is traversed.
task settle records one execution settlement; no collection is traversed.
task supersede links one old task to one replacement; no task collection is traversed.
task transition updates one task status; execution history is not enumerated by the status validator.
witness claim records one gate run claim; no collection is traversed.
witness rerun records one new gate run; no collection is traversed.
witness revoke records one gate run revocation; no collection is traversed.
witness settle records one gate result; no collection is traversed.
todo add runtime creates one todo item; no todo collection is traversed.
todo archive runtime updates one todo item; no todo collection is traversed.
todo done runtime updates one todo item; no todo collection is traversed.
todo promote runtime updates one todo item and target reference; no collection is traversed.
todo relate runtime writes one relation edge; owner relation traversal is measured by relation-relate.
todo reopen runtime updates one todo item; no collection is traversed.
vertical declaration migration writes one declaration; no collection is traversed.
vertical kind schema publication targets one kind; no collection is traversed.
vertical kind retirement targets one kind; no collection is traversed.
vertical kind upsert targets one kind definition; no collection is traversed.
Returns the selected skill evaluation catalog cases from the host-local catalog (skill-eval-production.ts), not canonical repository history; selected catalog cases are the explicit result k.
Reads the current fleet-center listener/address singleton in daemon host state (json-rpc-server.ts), with no repository projection or history enumeration.

Host status/handshake/control-receipt readers expose current daemon, process, registry or bounded control state, not canonical repository history (daemon-host-open.ts, gui-system-read.ts, gui-s3-control.ts).

Transport envelope dispatches the registered repo-read CLI actions. Every action is independently enumerated and covered as command:<id>; the envelope itself performs no projection read (repo-cell-action-dispatch.ts).
Validate the supplied declaration/source and current runtime instance catalog; validateAgentEntityAction does not query ledger history (agent-entities.ts:validateAgentEntityAction).

Read/validate current selected package assets or current active preset pointers (preset-system.ts, preset-catalog.ts); no canonical event, runtime, dispatch, output or relation history query. Canonical Settings selection is covered by cli-settings-read and repo.settings.read. Catalog size is the explicit result/input k.

Compose the current asset catalog plus one Settings singleton (gui-catalog.ts:openGuiCatalog); rereread invalidates the catalog digest. No history enumeration. Settings dependency is independently measured; current catalog membership is result k.
Reads one local run status receipt by runId, not canonical history (preset-run-status reader).
Discovers the currently installed skill directories (agent-skills.ts); no canonical ledger query. Returned installed skills are the explicit result k.
Reads current external Keycloak policy metadata (readPolicyMetadata), not repository history. No network or credentials are used by this repository-scale fixture.
Operate on current in-memory terminal sessions/processes, not canonical runtime-session history (daemon-host-runtime-api.ts).

Enumerates current registered repositories and opens each independently; current registry entries are input k (daemon-host-recovery.ts). Per-repository canonical startup readers are separately measured.
After measured squad-recovery hydrates state, reconciles current active runs from its in-memory Map and keyed dispatch/task reads; loop population is active work k (squad-coordinator.ts:reconcile).

Enumerates currently materialized local task worktrees, then reads each named task/snapshot; current worktrees are explicit input k, not a canonical task-history scan (task-worktree.ts:reconcileAbandonedTaskWorktrees).
